name: roc-mobile
description: Capacitor wrapper that packages the Rise of Civilizations web client into native iOS + Android apps.

scripts.apk: node build-mobile.mjs && cap sync android && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.apk:emulator: WS_URL=ws://127.0.0.1:3001/ws node build-mobile.mjs && cap sync android && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: node build-mobile.mjs && cap sync android && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.bundle:release: node build-mobile.mjs && cap sync android && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
